task.title: Planner: undo the last change
task.description:
Owner decision (2026-11-18): wanted, mainly to recover from mis-taps on the phone.

Wanted:
- After changing or clearing a slot (type button, new text, different recipe, clearing), a short-lived 'Undo' appears (toast or inline) and restores the slot exactly as it was, including its recipe, meal and leftovers link.
- Covers bulk actions too: a week copy undoes as one step.
- One level is enough for the first version; it need not survive a reload.

Notes: undo must not delete a recipe created by the undone action without saying so (recipes are now only created explicitly). Other slots that pointed at the changed slot as their leftovers source should be restored too.
